founder.name: María José Figueroa
bio: María José is a systems thinker, transformational consultant, and regenerative business strategist with deep experience in human-centered organizational design.

After years working in corporate environments, she witnessed firsthand how rapid scaling and misaligned structures lead to burnout, cultural fragmentation, and leadership disconnection — even inside purpose-driven companies.

COIREA was born from a simple truth: organizations don't transform through better processes alone. They transform when their leadership systems, cultural architecture, and human energy are aligned with a meaningful purpose.

Trained in conscious leadership, somatic intelligence, and regenerative design, María José integrates strategic clarity with deep inner work — combining business structure with human transformation. Her approach blends operating systems with emotional intelligence, governance with trust, and performance with well-being.
She has guided leadership teams, coached founders, and facilitated transformational offsites and retreats for organizations navigating complexity, cultural evolution, and intentional growth.

For her, the future belongs to organizations that can hold both structure and soul — places where people don't have to disconnect who they are to do the work they love. Transformation begins when leaders choose coherence — and build companies that honor both purpose and performance.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Organization?
cta.subtitle: Whether you're ready to begin or still exploring, we're here for the conversation.

items.question: What makes COIREA different from other organizational consultancies?
items.answer: COIREA integrates regenerative business principles with practical systems design. We don't just consult, we embed as partners to co-create sustainable transformation. Guided by our 5-Pillar Framework — purpose, leadership, collaboration, culture, well-being, and organizational strategy — we help organizations evolve into resilient, purpose-driven, self-managing systems.

items.question: How long does organizational transformation typically take?
items.answer: Our transformation programs range from 90-day intensive resets to 6-18 month comprehensive partnerships. The timeline depends on your organization's size, complexity, and transformation goals. We also offer ongoing fractional support for sustained evolution.

items.question: What is regenerative business and how does it apply to my organization?
items.answer: Regenerative business goes beyond sustainability to create systems that actively restore and revitalize. For organizations, this means building cultures and practices that strengthen both people and performance, creating positive impact while achieving business results.

items.question: How do you measure the success of organizational transformation?
items.answer: We use our COIREA Evolution Dashboard to track both quantitative metrics (productivity, retention, engagement) and qualitative indicators (leadership maturity, cultural coherence, well-being) across our 5-Pillar Framework, providing real-time insights into your organization's transformation progress.
